# OFS/T

> OFS/T sells pre-cut vinyl sticker kits for the Citroën Ami. Each kit covers the lower door panel and the rear quarter window of one side. 15 designs, from €39 per side, prices in EUR.

> A OFS/T vende kits de autocolantes em vinil pré-cortados para o Citroën Ami. Cada kit cobre o painel inferior da porta e o vidro lateral traseiro de um lado. 15 designs, a partir de 39 € por lado, preços em EUR.

Kits are outdoor vinyl, pre-cut, in matte or gloss, and fitted at home with a step-by-step guide. Options: two vinyl colours per design (except fixed-colour artwork), matte or gloss finish, second side +€29, custom badge text (up to 8 characters) +€9. OFS/T is independent and not affiliated with Citroën or Stellantis.

The site is bilingual: European Portuguese (pt-PT, the default, at https://ofstdesigns.com/) and English (under https://ofstdesigns.com/en/). Both languages have the same pages, designs and prices.

## English

- [Home](https://ofstdesigns.com/en/): overview, popular designs, how ordering and fitting work, compatible cars
- [Shop](https://ofstdesigns.com/en/shop/): all 15 designs with category and price per side
- [Configurator](https://ofstdesigns.com/en/configurator/): live preview on the Ami QuickSilver or Ami Pop; pick design, colours, finish, kit size and badge text. Deep link a design with ?design=<id> (add &model=pop for the Ami Pop)
- [About & FAQ](https://ofstdesigns.com/en/about/): who makes the kits; fitting time, car washes, removal, compatibility, custom designs

## Português

- [Início](https://ofstdesigns.com/): apresentação, designs populares, como encomendar e aplicar, carros compatíveis
- [Loja](https://ofstdesigns.com/shop/): os 15 designs, com categoria e preço por lado
- [Configurador](https://ofstdesigns.com/configurator/): pré-visualização em direto no Ami QuickSilver ou Ami Pop; design, cores, acabamento, tamanho do kit e texto do emblema. Ligação direta a um design com ?design=<id> (acrescente &model=pop para o Ami Pop)
- [Sobre nós e perguntas frequentes](https://ofstdesigns.com/about/): quem faz os kits; tempo de aplicação, lavagens, remoção, compatibilidade, designs personalizados
